sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can narrate the complete story of the 1241–1242 Tatar invasion (tatárjárás) in chronological order.
I can explain the significance of the Battle of Mohi and why IV. Béla is called the second founder of the state.
I can use all key historical grammar: warning verbs, battle verbs, mediopassive destruction, and fortification terms.
I can successfully answer historical and civic questions on the Mongol invasion for the naturalization exam.
